general_information.Description: The course demonstrates in-depth understanding of the circuit theory techniques for analysing resistive circuits and sinusoidal circuits. Furthermore, it introduces techniques for analysing the complete responses of RL, RC and RLC circuits. Finally, the powerful analytical technique based on the Laplace transform and a brief concept of frequency response are presented. During the course, Multisim, the supporting software for circuit analysis is also illustrated appropriately. Topic covered: Circuit variable; Circuit elements; Simple resistive circuits; Techniques of circuit analysis; Inductance, Capacitance, and Mutual Inductancel; Response of first-order RL adn RC circuits; Natural and step responses of RLC circuits; Sinusoidal steady-state analysis; Introduction to the Laplace Transform and Introduction to frequency selective circuits.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Usually access http://bigdatauniversity.com/ for downloading materials and reading
